name: Crusaders' Fervour
text: Every melee weapon carried by a model in the bearer's unit (an attached unit included) gets +1 to its Attacks characteristic. Ranged weapons are unaffected.

effect.name: Crusaders' Fervour
effect.text: Melee weapons carried by the bearer's unit have +1 Attacks.

name: Righteous Defiance
text: The bearer always shrugs off wounds on a 5+ (Feel No Pain 5+). Once per battle, when the bearer's unit (an attached unit included) is picked as the target of an attack, its owner may invoke this: until the end of that phase every model in the unit, the bearer included, has Feel No Pain 4+.

effect.name: Righteous Defiance
effect.text: The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+.

effect.name: Righteous Defiance
effect.text: Once per battle, when the bearer's unit is targeted in the Shooting phase, its models may gain Feel No Pain 4+ until the end of the phase.

effect.name: Righteous Defiance
effect.text: Once per battle, when the bearer's unit is targeted in the Fight phase, its models may gain Feel No Pain 4+ until the end of the phase.
